six_accelerator_stages.functionality_scope: Six intact substantial physical emitter/collector assemblies. Geometry audit does not certify reactor simulation, gameplay behavior, or energy output.

entrance_exact_20x20_prism.method: Clip actual triangles against full 438 m long rectangular clear prism, rather than only checking doorway labels or an AABB.
entrance_exact_20x20_prism.scope: 20 x 20 m is the nominal frame dimension. Exact free aperture is reduced by decorative guides, outer portal reveals, and ceiling insets. Traversability, physical contacts, source preservation and beam clearance are acceptance criteria. The source door/reveal at the inner join explicitly retain their smaller dimensions.

entrance_actual_clear_prism.method: Clip actual NEW triangles across the entire 438 m prism to prove free 19.6 x 19.99 m volume, plus independent width/height rays to identify limiting surfaces.
entrance_actual_clear_prism.source_transition: The preserved original entry at the inner join remains smaller; its 16 x 16 m frame and decorative reveals are unchanged.

preserved_facility_reveal.note: Unchanged source doorway trim is locally narrower than the nominal 16 m frame.

entrance_dimensions.note: The source 16 x 16 m facility door remains the overall bottleneck. New outer entrance does not widen that preserved door.

pedestrian_routes.body_model: Exact triangle distance to a vertical capsule: 0.7 m diameter, top 1.8 m above supporting floor, sole allowance 0.1 m.
pedestrian_routes.method: Densified <=0.5 m centerline samples and +/-1 m lateral lane samples. Actual floor support and upward headroom ray; exact segment/triangle distance for the capsule; full-height lateral rays at 0.25/0.9/1.7 m for width, compared with preserved doubled geometry alone.
pedestrian_routes.limits: Sampled geometric tests, not continuous swept-volume proof. Width rays may reach open adjacent spaces and do not establish off-route floor support. Separate +/-1 m lane tests include floor support. No engine collision or navigation claims.

serialized_glb_geometry.method: Read actual binary position/index accessors, compose scene-node world transforms, convert Y-up to Z-up, and test projected triangle interiors and edges.

serialized_triangle_equivalence.method: Compare complete triangle multiset after world transforms and Y-up conversion, quantized to 0.0001 m. Material splits and winding ignored.
serialized_triangle_equivalence.inference: When all actual triangles match, route/contact and entrance clearances also apply to exported surfaces within the stated 0.1 mm coordinate tolerance.

serialized_face_material_assignment.method: Full triangle/world-coordinate/material-name multiset compared for every exported mesh; material-driven vertex splitting and winding ignored.

scope_notes: Actual source mesh world vertices, topology, face material slots, and material shader definitions are compared with the immutable source.
Structural contact uses triangle-face intersection or robust volume containment. Counts/metadata/AABBs alone are not contact proof.
Full-height bore uses projection of every triangle interior and edge, repeated directly from serialized GLB buffers.
Walking route tests are sampled geometry checks with a 0.7 m-wide, 1.8 m-high human capsule at center and +/-1 m lane offsets; not a continuous swept-body or accessibility certification.
No Godot runtime collision or navigation shape certification, structural engineering analysis, or energy-output simulation is claimed.
acceptance_scope: Traversable entrance, human route/support/headroom clearance, structural contacts, beam clearance, retained source geometry/materials, height/arm/stage layout and assembled export. The builder nominal 20 x 20 m frame is not asserted to be an exact clear opening; measured 19.6 x 19.99 m effective new aperture and all 17 decorative intrusions are prominently retained as findings.
